transcript.text: Last spring I ended up eating my way through Nanjing for a couple days—honestly I still think about those meals.

transcript.speaker: user
transcript.text: And earlier in 2025 I had that quick work hop from Beijing over to Shanghai; it was one of those blink-and-it’s-over trips.

transcript.speaker: user
transcript.text: One lunch that really stuck with me was at Lao Men Dong Restaurant—my cousin picked it because it felt super old-school.

transcript.speaker: user
transcript.text: They’d set it up for 2025-05-15 at 12:00, which was perfect since we were all starving by noon.

transcript.speaker: user
transcript.text: There were 6 of us, and the reservation was under Cao Yun—pretty sure the contact number they left was 13877949128.

transcript.speaker: user
transcript.text: For that Beijing-to-Shanghai run, my colleague Qiu Lan was the one on the ticket—Air China, flight CA1234 on 2025-03-20, all already sorted back then.
